rust.msrv_policy: Exactly the qualified compiler; lower versions are not supported or claimed tested. Changes require owner review and native requalification.

cargo_lock.owner: S1 generates the real workspace lockfile with this exact Cargo version; no fabricated Q1 application lockfile
cargo_lock.policy: Commit the workspace lockfile; all subsequent build/test/clippy invocations use --locked. Review dependency/source/license deltas before updates. No unbounded git branches or floating toolchain channels.

Linux.mode: Retained release -O2, NDEBUG, PIC, MT/pthread, portable C optimized units; no enabled USE_ASM or ST_MODE override
Linux.runtime_policy: Matched libstdc++/libgcc/glibc; no Rust deallocation of native allocations

Windows.compiler_first_line: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.44.35228 for x64
Windows.mode: Retained -O1 -MT -EHsc -GR- -Gr -MP4, ml64 assembly; ABI exports and callbacks override -Gr with __cdecl
Windows.runtime_policy: Retained static MSVC runtime inside the native module; every allocation is released by its allocating module. No CRT FILE*, STL, exceptions or native memory ownership crosses to Rust. This is not static-link distribution approval.

Darwin.mode: Retained arm64 clang/PIC/MT build including selected arm64 assembly; natural C ABI layout
Darwin.runtime_policy: Matched Apple libc++ and SDK; legacy Format7zF uses the filename 7z.so even on macOS. That is not the eventual facade install name.

policy.on_version_drift: Fail closed against exact compiler, driver and selected runtime identity; retain logs and requalify a reviewed pin. Do not silently accept latest.
policy.local_supplement: Linux GCC 15.2.0-16ubuntu1 / GNU Make 4.4.1 also built the retained products locally. This does not replace the canonical native CI pins.
policy.qt: Not selected or installed by Q1; Q2 owns exact Qt 6/CXX-Qt/cxx pins after CLI/filesystem gates.
policy.license: Retained selected input obligations are in license-inventory.json and license-inventory.md. No release or GUI linkage authorization.
policy.target_expansion: Other OS/architecture/32-bit/MinGW/musl targets require separate native qualification before exposure.
